resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Central Lookouts page header names the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources. The county list and A-Z list code the owner as MFS (Minnesota Forest Service), which the county footnote says is now the DNR. The record keeps the DNR name as the current agency and the story does not name a 1938 agency.

The 1938 NGS description puts the station in section 35, T. 146 N., R. 36 W. The Central Lookouts header and the A-Z list give 145N-36W, section 2. The sources do not agree, so the story gives no township.

notes_for_editor: Very thin record. No build date, height, design or staffing appears in any source read, so the story leaves them out. The gone status and the 1938 dismantling come from the county list and survey notes. No source describes the site today, and the county forest land note does not say whether visitors may go there. A firetower.org page for this site was not in the cache (404). Search budget: two searches.
